# Await Account Hub view readiness before showing the modal

AccountHubController awaits a view’s ready promise when creating it and when reusing it. open awaits the selected view before showModal. openAccountHub first awaits controller.ready and then open. The email view assigns its initialization promise to ready. Preserve this full promise path when adding an asynchronous Account Hub view. This prevents exposing an unfinished view; it does not prove that background image decoding or every fire-and-forget open-view caller is awaited. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or accessibility session was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.

Scope: Account Hub asynchronous readiness.
